hero.eyebrow: Open-source finance research agent · 🇰🇷 Korean market fork
hero.title: Turn Korean market questions into runnable research.
hero.lead: Vibe-Trading-KR is the Korean-market fork of Vibe-Trading — natural-language research over market data, backtests, and swarm analysis, plus Korean broker connectors (KIS · LS · DB · Kiwoom) and KRX backtesting.
install.title: One command to start a research workspace.
korea.title: Korean broker connectors & KRX backtesting.
korea.card1.title: Broker connectors
korea.card1.body: KIS · LS · DB · Kiwoom REST registered as broker_sdk profiles; Kiwoom OpenAPI+ and Daishin CYBOS as Windows local bridges. Status is tracked conservatively — real-account orders stay behind mandate, kill switch, and audit gates.
korea.card2.title: KRX backtesting
korea.card2.body: 005930.KS, 035720.KQ, KRX:005930 route to kr_equity. KRX 1-share lot and ±30% daily limit modeled; benchmark resolves to KOSPI ^KS11.
korea.card3.title: Credentials & safety
korea.card3.body: Broker keys come from environment variables; per-connector config is stored under ~/.vibe-trading with 0600 permissions. Live order paths require credentialed smoke evidence first.
wiki.title: Explore Vibe-Trading-KR.
loop.title: Every answer keeps the trail inspectable.
loop.route.title: Route
loop.route.body: Select skills, data sources, tools, and swarm teams from the request.
loop.ground.title: Ground
loop.ground.body: Fetch market data, documents, URLs, broker journals, or local files at runtime.
loop.test.title: Test
loop.test.body: Run backtests, factor analysis, options checks, validation, and report generation.
loop.deliver.title: Deliver
loop.deliver.body: Return run cards, exports, reports, tool traces, and caveats for the next session.
cap.title: Built for finance research, not brokerage execution.
cap.harness.title: Agent Harness
cap.harness.body: Persistent memory, session search, editable skills, context compression, and tool-batched research runs.
cap.backtest.title: Backtesting
cap.backtest.body: Seven engines across equities, crypto, futures, forex, composites, and options portfolios.
cap.swarm.title: Swarm Teams
cap.swarm.body: Investment committee, quant desk, risk review, macro, crypto, and other preset research teams.
cap.shadow.title: Shadow Account
cap.shadow.body: Parse broker journals, extract implicit rules, run counterfactual backtests, and render audit reports.
safety.title: No live trading.
safety.body: Vibe-Trading is for research, simulation, and backtesting. It does not execute live trades and does not provide investment advice.
